results.title: Troops Rescue Kidnap Victim, Recover 18 Rustled Cattle in Kebbi By: Zagazola Makama Troops of the Nigerian Army have rescued a kidnap victim
results.description:
Troops Rescue Kidnap Victim, Recover 18 Rustled Cattle in Kebbi

By: Zagazola Makama

Troops of the Nigerian Army have rescued a kidnap victim and recovered 18 rustled cattle during a security operation in Rambo Village, Danko-Wasagu Local Government Area of Kebbi State.

Security sources told Zagazola Makama that the operation took place at about 2:50 a.m. on Oct. 18, when troops of 223 Battalion, deployed at Forward Operating Base (FOB) Kanya, responded to reports of terrorist activities in the community.

The troops engaged the suspected terrorists and successfully rescued one kidnap victim during the operation.
They also recovered 18 cattle believed to have been rustled by the criminal elements.

The rescued victim was reunited with his family, while the recovered cattle were handed over to their rightful owner through the District Head of Rambo Village.

SAD NEWS: This morning, bandits reportedly killed two people along the Adafka–Duhuwa road in Bukkuyum LGA, Zamfara State.

This afternoon, bandits also blocked a road from Lauwali Junction-Gusau town in Gusau LGA and shot a driver.

How long must residents and road users continue to live in fear before the authorities take decisive action to protect innocent lives?
